analysis.executive_summary: Tecnomania is a Consumer electronics retail opportunity at Tender / RFQ stage. The automation recommends conditional pursue: price only serviceable scope and require leadership review. Serviceable volume is 2,207,520 parcels annually (6,048 daily), not the full raw opportunity. Key exclusions include Spain - Canary Islands, Ceuta & Melilla, Portugal - Mainland, Portugal - Madeira & Azores, Standard return shipments from customer to Tecnomania.

scenarios.label: Aggressive
scenarios.rationale: Use only if Amazon needs a sharp entry price and leadership accepts minimum-margin risk.
scenarios.trade_offs: Maximizes price competitiveness but leaves little room for concessions. Includes SOD premium controls.
scenarios.negotiation_strategy: Use as a floor only after the customer confirms all unsupported scope is removed or split.

scenarios.label: Balanced
scenarios.rationale: Recommended anchor because it meets the finance target while preserving room to negotiate.
scenarios.trade_offs: Balances competitiveness with the 21% target margin and keeps negotiation room. Includes SOD, OTP premium controls.
scenarios.negotiation_strategy: Lead with this option and frame it around service reliability, peak readiness, and transparent pricing.

scenarios.label: Conservative
scenarios.rationale: Use when the customer values resilience, premium controls, and implementation certainty over lowest price.
scenarios.trade_offs: Protects margin and execution risk, but may weaken price-score competitiveness. Includes SOD, OTP premium controls.
scenarios.negotiation_strategy: Use as the executive-safe option for high-value electronics with OTP/SOD and strict scope carve-outs.

commercial_strategy.positioning: Lead with serviceable Iberian Spain scope, high-value proof-of-delivery controls, and strict carve-outs for Portugal, returns, heavy parcels, and PUDO fallback.
talk_tracks: Peak resilience and maintained delivery attempts
Transparent pricing tied to serviceable scope

required_follow_up_actions.question: Confirm that the customer accepts Amazon Shipping pricing only for serviceable scope.
Review the balanced scenario before customer-facing proposal release.
Validate parcel-level exclusion method for over-15kg and oversize electronics before contract language.
Confirm whether Tecnomania accepts separate handling for Portugal, Canary/Ceuta/Melilla, returns, and PUDO fallback.

sections.heading: Executive Recommendation
sections.body: Conditional pursue: price only serviceable scope and require leadership review.

sections.heading: Proposed Scope
sections.body: Amazon Shipping proposes to serve 2,207,520 annual parcels within supported Spain scope, subject to parcel-level eligibility checks.

sections.heading: Pricing Anchor
sections.body: Balanced scenario: EUR 2.35 per parcel at 21% target contribution margin.

sections.heading: Explicit Exclusions
sections.body: Spain - Canary Islands, Ceuta & Melilla; Portugal - Mainland; Portugal - Madeira & Azores; Standard return shipments from customer to Tecnomania; Pickup point / parcel locker fallback; Parcels above 15kg or above 80x80x60cm

sections.heading: Implementation Plan
sections.body: Confirm scope, validate parcel data, complete API readiness review, run peak-readiness governance, then release final proposal.

Supported challenge scope is Peninsular Spain and Balearics, 1-2 day delivery, OTP/SOD, max 15kg, max 80x80x60cm.
10% of parcels are XL/XXL up to 110x80x30cm, above the 80x80x60cm challenge size envelope.
Spain Peninsula 80%, Balearics 4%, Canary/Ceuta/Melilla 2%, Portugal Mainland 12%, Madeira/Azores 2%.
Tecnomania asks for pickup point / locker fallback after failed home delivery attempts.
Tecnomania expects returns volume of approximately 8.5% of forward shipments.
Tecnomania requires a minimum of three home-delivery attempts.
Tecnomania requires API label, manifest, tracking, claims, and webhook integration.
6% of parcels are 15-20kg and 4% are 20-30kg, above the 15kg challenge limit.
